item.description:
＜ロンドン株式市場＞
まちまちで取引を終えた。ヒーリー英財務相が発表した初の予算案で、銀行などの課税の引き上げ幅が懸...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州市場サマリー（28日） 4:01 配信

＜ロンドン株式市場＞

まちまちで取引を終えた。ヒーリー英財務相が発表した初の予算案で、銀行などの課税の引き上げ幅が懸念されたほどではなかったとして関連株が上昇した。ＦＴＳＥ１００種は小幅に反発。一方、中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は０．３１％安と反落した。

ＦＴＳＥ３５０種銀行株指数は１．１０％高。通期目標を引き上げた英銀大手スタンダード・チャータードは２．４％上昇。オンラインカジノなどを運営するエンテインは３．６％値上がりした。

ブレント原油先物価格の上昇を受けて、石油・ガス株指数は０．８４％高。

住宅建設株指数は６．０４％下落した。生活必需品株指数は１．４１％安。日用品のユニリーバは２．１％下落した。

製薬大手ＧＳＫは４．８％値下がりした。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞

小幅に続伸して取引を終えた。米欧の金融政策を見極めたいとして、投資家の間に様子見姿勢が見られた。

イタリアの主要株価ＦＴＳＥ・ＭＩＢ指数は０．４０％上昇。一方、銀行株の比重が高いスペインのＩＢＥＸ指数は１．４５％下落した。

ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種メディア株指数は２．１４％安。音楽大手ユニバーサル・ミュージック・グループ（ＵＭＧ）は４．３％値下がりした。銅価格の値下がりを受けて資源株指数は０．７５％下落した。

オランダの決済サービス会社アディエンは業績への懸念から１３．４％安。

スペインの銀行サンタンデールは５．６％安。ブラジルでの事業不振が響いた。スイスの金融大手ＵＢＳは０．６％下落した。ドイツ銀行は４．０％上昇。直近四半期の決算が市場の減益予想に反して増益となり、買われた。

自動車・部品株指数は１．３３％高。自動車大手のステランティスは１５．４％上昇した。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞

域内国債利回りが上昇し、特にフランス国債利回りが大幅に上昇した。新たな供給懸念から原油価格が再び上昇する中、主要中央銀行による政策金利決定に注目が集まっている。

ユーロ圏の指標であるドイツ１０年国債利回りは約１ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇の３．３６３５％となった。

欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）の政策金利見通しに敏感な独２年債利回りは６ｂｐ上昇の３．１１％。

フランス１０年債利回りは３ｂｐ上昇の４．９４％。

ＥＣＢは２９日に開く理事会で、２０２６年に２回の利上げを実施した後、金利を据え置くと予想されている。

item.title: Alvin Hellerstein, Judge in Maduro, 9/11 Cases, Dies at 92
item.description: Veteran federal judge Alvin Hellerstein, who oversaw cases against Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro, Archegos Capital Management family office founder Bill Hwang and litigation over the 9/11 terrorist attack, died at 92.
item.dc:creator: list.metadata.agency
item.content:encoded: (Bloomberg) -- Veteran federal judge Alvin Hellerstein, who oversaw cases against Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro, Archegos Capital Management family office founder Bill Hwang and litigation over the 9/11 terrorist attack, died at 92. The Jewish Center, a synagogue in Manhattan, notified congregants that Hellerstein, a longtime member and trustee, had died. The US District Court for the Southern District of New York said the the judge passed away Wednesday morning, surrounded by family.“Judge Hellerstein was an insightful and dedicated lawyer who, following a distinguished career in the private sector, served with distinction for over 25 years as a distinguished jurist of this court,” Chief Judge Laura Swain said in a statement. “His energetic and dedicated service to this court continued until his death.”Hellerstein, a native New Yorker, served in the Army’s Judge Advocate General’s Corps before joining New York City law firm Stroock & Stroock & Lavan LLP in 1960. He was appointed to the bench by President Bill Clinton in 1998. Since then, he has overseen high-profile white collar prosecutions and complex litigation. Most recently, he was overseeing the narco-terrorism case against Maduro and his wife Cilia Flores. The couple are scheduled to face trial in June. New judges will be assigned at random to the Maduro case and the other cases Hellerstein was overseeing.During his early years on the bench, Hellerstein built his reputation overseeing yearslong litigation related to the Sept. 11, 2001, attacks. In 2010, he rejected a settlement for 10,000 rescue and cleanup workers who fell ill working at Ground Zero because the payouts may have been too small after attorney fees were taken out. Months later, Hellerstein approved a $712 million pact well over the original proposal. In a separate case, he ruled against families seeking to recover human remains from the 9/11 debris. In the courtroom, the Columbia Law School graduate was famous for interrupting lawyers who weren’t questioning witnesses to his satisfaction or losing the jury’s attention. In the 2024 criminal trial of Hwang, whose family office meltdown caused chaos across Wall Street, Hellerstein interrupted the questioning of a witness to announce the birth of his great-grandchild. “It’s a gorgeous baby,” remarked Hellerstein as he turned his phone to bemused lawyers in the courtroom. The jury erupted in applause. In the same trial, he chided a lawyer for boring the jury to tears. ‘Just and Measured’He sentenced Hwang to 18 years in prison, a decision that the judge never took lightly.In rare public comments, Hellerstein, an Orthodox Jew, has spoken about how his faith intersected with his work. He told a podcast in 2020 that he held sentencing hearings on Fridays so he could used Sabbath to reflect on the consequences of his decisions.“I never ever have had the feeling that my punishment was just and measured,” he said. “And that’s good. I think a judge should be disconcerted with what he does. I’m taking away the liberty of someone.” In recent years, Hellerstein oversaw trials involving Charlie Javice, the start-up founder convicted of defrauding JPMorgan Chase, as well as a human rights case against BNP Paribas. Roger Stavis, the head of Mintz & Gold’s white collar defense practice, who’s tried cases before Hellerstein, recalled him having a sense of humor that made him likeable even when Stavis was losing. ‘Dayenu’In one hearing in Hellerstein’s courtroom in lower Manhattan, Stavis recalled objecting to the prosecution introducing the same evidence over and over. The judge shot back at Stavis, asking him to identify the legal precedent on how many times is too many. “I said ‘United States v. Dayenu’ — the Hebrew term for it would have been enough — and he started cracking up,” Stavis said. (Adds details on previous cases, history)More stories like this are available on bloomberg.com©2026 Bloomberg L.P.

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
〔情報ＢＯＸ〕ウォーシュ米ＦＲＢ議長の会見要旨 3:51 配信

写真は米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のウォーシュ議長。10月28日撮影。（ロイター） ［２８日　ロイター］ - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は２７─２８日に開いた連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）でフェデラルファンド（ＦＦ）金利誘導目標を３．７５－４．００％に据え置くと決定した。

ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長がＦＯＭＣ後に行った会見の内容は以下の通り。

＊ＦＯＭＣはより多くの情報が適切な政策スタンスの決定に寄与すると考えている

＊ＦＯＭＣは（経済の）先行きを注視しているが、状況は容易になっていない

＊成長は力強さを増している

＊第３・四半期の国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）は３％を上回る公算

＊企業の設備投資は２桁の伸びとなる可能性が高い

＊企業の設備投資は２桁ペースで増加する公算

＊雇用者数の伸びは２０２５年のペースを上回っている

＊雇用情勢は良好

＊われわれの責務はインフレを押し下げること

＊ＦＲＢ内の議論は主に物価安定の責務に焦点が当てられた

＊信用状況はタイト化している

＊市場参加者は資本配分についてより慎重になっている

＊金融状況がタイトだとは言いたくないし、言うこともできない

＊ＦＯＭＣでは活発な議論が交わされた

＊しかしそれらは、より持続的な経済成長と物価安定の方向に向かうものだ

＊地政学や技術についても議論した

＊金融市場のボラティリティーには驚いていない

＊実体経済の活動は正しい方向に向かっている

＊インフレは高すぎる

＊われわれの仕事は、一部セクターでの相対的な価格変動が広範に波及しないようにすることだ

＊われわれは行動する用意があることを明確にした

＊今後得られる情報が、政策をどこに位置づけたいかの判断に役立つだろう

＊来年の秋にＦＯＭＣの日程を変更することを決定した

＊年８回の会合が適切な回数だ

＊うち１回の会合では政策金利の採決を行わない

＊１回の会合は戦略に焦点を当てたものとなる

＊２０２８年には政策決定会合を年６回とする見通し

＊より長い時間軸を見据えた戦略的な審議のために、時間と余地を確保することが重要

●質疑応答

＜金融政策・利下げ判断＞

＊物価の安定を確実にすることは、カレンダー上の特定の日付に関するものではない

＊金融政策の処方薬が効き始めているというのが、ＦＯＭＣの圧倒的な判断だ

＊金融緩和の度合いを一部取り除いた際、金融市場の状況への影響は想定通りだった

＊われわれは現状を見極め、今後の期間がより明確な判断材料を与えてくれるかを問うことにした

＊今後も豊富な情報が入手可能となるが、政治とは一切関係がない

＜先行きの政策運営＞

＊危機時を除き、フォワードガイダンスを信じていない

＊１２月に何が起こるかについての個人的な思いは共有しない

＊それまでに多くのことが分かるかもしれず、そうなれば、適切な政策判断を下しやすい状況になるだろう

＜インフレ・物価安定＞

＊世界情勢が不安定な中でも、期待インフレは正しい方向に向かっている

＊これまでに達成した進展に勇気づけられている

＊われわれは物価安定に向けて取り組んでいる

＊緩やかなインフレ目標というものは存在しない

＊物価安定の目標は、個人消費支出（ＰＣＥ）価格指数２％だ

＊期待インフレは短期的には上昇したものの、より長期の指標を見ると、家計も企業もＦＲＢが物価安定を実現すると信頼していることが分かる

＜景気・経済情勢＞

＊経済は力強い

＊経済は正しい方向に向かっている

＊経済は過熱しているか。それは私の同僚の大半の判断ではない

＊生産性は上昇してきている

＊経済成長は高まっているが、それがインフレを引き起こしているとは限らない

＊経済の動きを妨げたり、混乱を引き起こしたりすることが目標ではない

＊人々を失業に追い込む必要があるとは思わない

＜金融環境・引き締めの効果＞

＊われわれは金融環境を引き締めている

＊それはわれわれの政策が奏功していることを示しており、不安は感じていない

＜ＦＯＭＣの運営・政策枠組み＞

＊私には１８人の極めて独立した同僚がいる

＊私は全てを見通す全知全能のような者ではない

＊戦略会合で政策声明を出すことは想定していない

＊ＦＯＭＣの新たな形式に関する決定は新しいもので、詳細は後日発表する

＜作業部会（タスクフォース）＞

＊５つの作業部会（タスクフォース）が精力的に取り組んでおり、定期的な進捗確認を行ってきた

＊一部の作業部会は年末の期限に間に合う見通し

＊作業部会の結論が、今回の政策判断の局面に反映される可能性は低い

＊１１月１６日に開かれる生産性に関する作業部会の公聴会に出席する

＜バランスシート＞

＊バランスシートに関する作業部会の提言は、第1・四半期の早い時期にＦＯＭＣに反映される

＊バランスシートの変更を決定したとしても、今回の政策判断の局面に影響を及ぼす可能性は低い

＊バランスシートへのいかなる変更も、作業部会の提言を慎重に検討した上で行う

＜金利と市場・原油＞

＊原油価格の上昇と市場で決まる金利の間には、最近まで安定した相関関係があった

＊金利は下向きに転じた

＊原油先物価格が上昇していることに留意している

＊一部の資産で信用スプレッドが拡大し、一部の金融環境で引き締まりが見られた

＜金利とＡＩ・設備投資＞

＊金利が人工知能（ＡＩ）に影響を与えないという見方に、私は懐疑的だった

＊金利はほぼ全てのものに影響する

＊９月初め以降、テクノロジー関連分野の内外で、金利が影響を及ぼしているのを見てきた

＊金利は新しいテクノロジーにとって確かに重要だ

＊設備投資は裾野が広がりつつある

＊設備投資の力強さは、もはや狭い分野に限られていない

＜韓国経済・海外＞

＊韓国経済に多くの注意を払っている。今後何が来るかを教えてくれるからだ

＜政治との関係＞

＊（中間選挙が金利判断に影響したかと問われ）政治は何の影響も及ぼさなかった

＊ＦＯＭＣの審議で、政治や選挙への言及は一切聞かれなかった

＊政治は、私だけでなく同僚にとっても何の影響も及ぼさなかった

＜その他＞

＊クックＦＲＢ理事を巡る手続きについて問われ、ＦＲＢは「私の知る限り」関与しない

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：金価格、米国債利回り上昇でも4000ドル台維持　中銀の準備資産分散が下支え コラム：何が豪ドルを動かしているのか＝高島修氏 コラム：トランプ米大統領、任期中の利下げは望み薄　市場は高金利長期化を想定 コラム：ドル／円の昨年高値更新に現実味、中立金利や介入効果に注目＝内田稔氏 コラム：9月ＦＯＭＣ、ドットプロット更新で金利見通しに波乱も 10/29(木) 5:02 最終更新 ロイター

FAST

LOS ANGELES, Oct 28 : Kathleen Kennedy, a veteran Hollywood producer and the former president of "Star Wars" film studio Lucasfilm, will lead production of the opening and closing ceremonies for the 2028 Olympics and Paralympics in Los Angeles, organizers said on Wednesday. Kennedy was named head of ceremonies and content for the Games, replacing Peter Rice, who recently took a job at Netflix.  She stepped down as president of Lucasfilm in January. Founder George Lucas had chosen her to lead the studio when he sold it to Disney in 2012. Kennedy co-founded Amblin Entertainment with Steven Spielberg and Frank Marshall, whom she later married, and helped produce classic movies including "E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial," "Jurassic Park" and "Schindler's List."

FAST

BRUSSELS, Oct 28 : Meta announced on Wednesday that it was indefinitely delaying the rollout of its new commercial terms following concerns from publishers and digital advertisers, in a move that could stave off potential regulatory action. EU and UK antitrust authorities have received complaints about the new terms, which publishers and digital advertisers said would give Meta an unlimited right to use their content for its AI services. Meta has rejected the claims. "We've heard publishers' feedback on our proposed ads and business terms update. We care deeply about our partners and do not plan to make policy changes without a full consultation with industry groups and leaders," Meta said in a statement. "We're committed to getting this right, and we expect this consultation could extend beyond November 20, in which case we'd delay implementation of the updated terms. Until then our existing terms remain in place," added Meta.

Source: Reuters

Oracle eases AI spending worries with plan to turn cash flow positive

FILE PHOTO: The Oracle logo is shown on an office building in Irvine, California, U.S. June 28, 2018. REUTERS/Mike Blake/File Photo

29 Oct 2026 02:36AM (Updated: 29 Oct 2026 03:59AM)

FAST

Oct 28 : Oracle said on Wednesday it expects capital spending to peak this fiscal year and next as it builds more cloud-computing capacity, but pledged to raise no more than $20 billion in additional financing for AI through fiscal 2030. The pledge is meant to reassure investors worried that Larry Ellison's company will need ever-larger sums of outside money to fund its aggressive data-center buildout. Oracle shares jumped over 12 per cent on the forecasts, while other cloud stocks also rose. Speaking at Oracle's investor day in Las Vegas, CFO Hilary Maxson said Oracle also expects free cash flow to turn positive in the second half of fiscal 2028 and top $30 billion in fiscal 2029, when capital spending is set to decline. "Oracle is trying to show investors that there's a method to the madness of its massive AI infrastructure spending," Emarketer analyst Jacob Bourne said.

"Though the projections are ambitious and far from guaranteed, they demonstrate an understanding of investors' concerns and offer an optimistic path toward addressing them." Oracle has become a focal point of worries about the soaring cost of AI infrastructure because it lacks the deep revenue base of cloud giants such as Microsoft and Amazon and relies heavily on a single customer, loss-making ChatGPT creator OpenAI. The partnership with OpenAI has added hundreds of billions of dollars to Oracle's cloud backlog, but building the data centers and other AI infrastructure needed to fulfill those contracts has forced it to lean heavily on debt and stock sales. PLANS TO CUT BACK ON OUTSIDE FINANCING Oracle said on Wednesday it expects vendor financing, customer-provided hardware and customer pre-payments to reduce its upfront cash needs until free cash flow turns positive. It expects to stop relying on outside funding for growth from fiscal 2029, with net debt forecast to fall below 3.5 times its annual core earnings that year. The company said earlier this year it would raise $40 billion through debt and equity financing in its current fiscal year, including the $20 billion stock sale it completed in the first quarter. It had $125.34 billion in notes payable and other borrowings as of August 31, while cash and cash equivalents totaled around $36.37 billion. "I've told you we need an additional up to $20 billion in funding for the remainder of our fiscal 2027," Maxson said. "We're announcing that this $20 billion, split evenly between debt and equity, is the final amount needed to fund the remainder of this cycle." Oracle's five-year credit default swaps, which measure the cost of insuring against a default on its debt, were down marginally at 287.2 basis points on Wednesday. Maxson's remarks lifted shares of AI cloud and infrastructure companies after weeks of selling pressure over worries that the AI boom is becoming too dependent on debt. CoreWeave, Nebius, Applied Digital and Iren gained between 2.1 per cent and 5 per cent. For fiscal 2030, Oracle forecast revenue of more than $225 billion, an adjusted operating margin above 40 per cent and adjusted earnings of more than $21 per share. It reaffirmed its fiscal 2027 forecast of more than $90 billion in revenue and adjusted earnings of $8.10 per share.

Source: Reuters

item.title: US goods trade deficit widens in September as AI boom drives imports to record high
item.description: According to Reuters, US goods trade deficit widened from $2.8 billion to $134.9 billion in September. While imports of goods increase $8.1 billion to $344.1 billion, goods exports climbed from $5.3 billion to $209.2 billion.
item.dc:creator: Sneha Biswas
item.content:encoded: The US trade deficit in goods widened more than expected in September. This comes as imports climbed to a record high. According to Reuters, the surge is driven by demand for capital goods associated with the artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure boom, indicating that trade could have weighed heavily on economic growth in the third quarter. The latest deterioration in the trade balance is reported by the Commerce Department on Wednesday, as per the news agency. Reportedly, it prompted some economists to estimate that trade may have shaved as much as four percentage points off Gross Domestic Product (GDP) growth in the July-September quarter. However, the government's advance estimate of third-quarter GDP, scheduled for release on Thursday, is still expected to show strong growth, supported by a surge in AI-related investments and resilient consumer spending. "Although trade will weigh on quarterly GDP, this is a sign of strength rather than weakness for the US economy as it signifies continued business investment and momentum for consumer spending," said Daniel Vielhaber, an economist at Nationwide, as quoted by Reuters. US goods trade The goods trade deficit rose 2.1%, or $2.8 billion, to $134.9 billion in September. It marked the highest level since March 2025, the Commerce Department's Census Bureau said. Economists surveyed by Reuters had predicted the deficit to come in at $130.2 billion. The goods trade gap continued to widen through the third quarter. Imports of goods increased 2.4%, or $8.1 billion, to a record $344.1 billion in September, led by a 7.5% increase in capital goods. Capital goods imports surged 77.2% from a year earlier. "So much of the hardware that the tech companies need is coming from overseas, driving a massive widening in the trade gap," said Stephen Stanley, chief US economist at Santander US Capital Markets to Reuters. Imports vs exports Besides the AI investment boom, sustained consumer spending despite rising living costs has also been cited as contributing to the increase in imports. Consumer goods imports rose 3.1% in September, while imports of other goods increased 6.7%. Imports of industrial supplies, which include gold and petroleum, declined 6.0%. For the unversed, gold is excluded from the calculation of GDP. Imports of food and motor vehicles also fell during the month. In terms of export, shipments of goods increased $5.3 billion, or 2.6%, to $209.2 billion in September. Food exports jumped 12.8%, while exports of capital goods rose 5.4% and consumer products advanced 6.5%. Exports of motor vehicles and industrial supplies also saw a decline, Reuters reported. Trade weighs on GDP growth Economists estimated that trade could subtract four percentage points from GDP growth in the third quarter, while those at Oxford Economics put the drag at 3.25 percentage points. Trade has not contributed to US GDP growth for three consecutive quarters, added the report. However, it is believed that a portion of September's imports ended up as unsold inventory at wholesalers and retailers, which could potentially help cushion the impact on GDP. The Census Bureau reported that wholesale inventories increased 0.6% in September. Reportedly, retail inventories rose 0.3%. Stocks at motor vehicle and parts dealers increased 0.2%. Apart from motor vehicles and parts, retail inventories rose 0.4% in September after edging up 0.1% in August. Previously, a Reuters survey of economists had forecast the US economy to grow at an annualised rate of 3.2% in the third quarter, compared with 2.2% in the second quarter.

item.title: 米ＦＲＢ、10対2で金利据え置き 議長「物価安定は未達成」
item.description:
Howard Schneider
[ワシントン／ニューヨーク ２８日 ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は２７...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米ＦＲＢ、10対2で金利据え置き　議長「物価安定は未達成」 3:16 配信

２０１２年８月撮影　REUTERS/Larry Downing（ロイター） Howard Schneider

[ワシントン／ニューヨーク　２８日　ロイター] - 米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は２７─２８日に開いた連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）でフェデラルファンド（ＦＦ）金利誘導目標を３．７５－４．００％に据え置くと決定した。決定は１０対２。１１月３日に中間選挙を控える中、インフレ動向に関する一段のデータを見極める姿勢を示した。

ＦＲＢは声明で、インフレはなお高水準にあると指摘するとともに、景気判断を引き上げ、今後のインフレ動向次第では追加利上げを実施する可能性を示唆した。ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長は「経済活動の足かせ」となって成長を鈍化させたり、失業率を押し上げたりすることなく、インフレ率を目標の２％に引き下げられるとの自信を示した。

ウォーシュ氏はＦＯＭＣ後の記者会見で、ＦＲＢはなお物価安定を達成していないとの認識を示し、「その実現に向けて取り組んでいる」と述べた。同時に「会合の結果を予断することはしない」と改めて表明。「さまざまなことが起こり得る。６週間後にこのメンバーが再び集まった際に何が起きるかについて、私個人の考えをお話しすることはできない」と述べ、今後の金融政策運営について具体的な指針は示さなかった。

２９日発表の第３・四半期国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）統計について、投資と個人消費の堅調さや、年前半からの成長加速を示すと予想した。ただ、米経済が「過熱している」とも、抑制が必要な需要サイドのインフレを生んでいるとも考えていないと述べた。

「米経済は正しい方向に向かっている。経済は過熱しているのか。強すぎるのか。それは大半の委員が下している判断ではない」とし、人工知能（ＡＩ）ブーム以前からの生産性の変化によって、米経済はインフレをそれほど高めずに、より速いペースで成長できる可能性があるとの見方を改めて示した。

ＦＲＢの目的は「経済活動の足かせになることでも、人々を失業させることでもない。そうする必要があるとは思わない」と述べた。

むしろ、ＦＲＢの利上げが信用環境をやや引き締める形で既に影響を及ぼしており、例えば企業投資を鈍化させる可能性があるほか、最近の株価下落の一因となったとも言えると指摘。これが富裕層世帯の支出を鈍らせれば、インフレ鈍化のもう一つの要因になり得るとした。

ＦＲＢは前回９月のＦＯＭＣで３年２か月ぶりの利上げを決定。今回はクック理事とクリーブランド地区連銀のハマック総裁が２会合連続となる０．２５％ポイントの利上げを主張し、金利据え置きに反対票を投じた。

クック理事が金融政策決定を巡り反対票を投じるのは初めて。クック理事を巡ってはトランプ大統領が解任を求めている。ウォーシュ議長は記者会見で、トランプ大統領が進めているクック氏に対する調査に自身は関与しないと述べた。

＜中間選挙控え難しい舵取り＞

中間選挙を目前に控える中、ＦＲＢは難しいかじ取りを迫られており、ウォーシュ議長は記者会見で、今回のＦＯＭＣで金利据え置きを決定したことに政治的な考慮は一切なかったと強調。「政治は今回の決定に全く影響していない。この２日間、委員会のメンバーと共に過ごしたが、政治についての発言は一切聞かなかった。選挙や今後１週間の政治情勢への言及もなかった」と述べた。

その上で「今回のＦＯＭＣでは激しい議論があった」とし、「現時点では適切な政策判断に達したと考えている。この委員会の一員であり、議長を務めることを光栄に思う」と述べた。

＜声明は景気判断引き上げ＞

今回の声明には、ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長が避けたい意向を示していたフォワードガイダンスを想起させる内容が盛り込まれ、９月の声明から変化が見られた。ＦＲＢは今回の声明で、経済活動については「力強い（strong）ペースで拡大している」とし、前回の「堅調な（solid）ペースで拡大している」から判断を引き上げた。

物価情勢については「インフレ率は依然として高い水準にある」とし、「より多くの情報を収集することで、インフレ率を委員会が掲げる目標の２％へ速やかに戻すために、委員会は適切な政策スタンスを決定していく」とした上で、「委員会は物価の安定を実現する」と表明。労働市場については「雇用の伸びは労働人口の増加に追い付いており、失業率はあまり変化していない」とした。

＜据え置きは予想通り＞

金利据え置きは広く予想されていたため、金融市場の反応は限定的だった。米国株は決定後に上げ幅をやや縮小したものの、上昇して取引を終えた。米長期債利回りは上昇幅を拡大。短期金利先物は、トレーダーが今後の利上げ観測をやや後退させたことで小幅に上昇した。

ただ、オックスフォード・エコノミクスのチーフ米国エコノミスト、マイケル・ピアース氏は「ＦＲＢがタカ派姿勢を続ける背景にある要因は薄れていない。軽油とガソリンの価格は依然として高く、ＡＩ主導のインフレは和らいでおらず、労働市場も底堅さを保っている」と述べた。

アンパサンドのケリー・ブラウン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）も「金利据え置きは安心材料ではない」と指摘。「ＦＲＢは実体経済に対し、もうしばらく様子を見るよう求めている。インフレ率が３．７％となお高水準にあり、原油価格が１バレル＝１００ドルを超える中、企業は借入コストが近く低下すると期待することはできない」と述べた。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：金価格、米国債利回り上昇でも4000ドル台維持　中銀の準備資産分散が下支え コラム：何が豪ドルを動かしているのか＝高島修氏 コラム：トランプ米大統領、任期中の利下げは望み薄　市場は高金利長期化を想定 コラム：ドル／円の昨年高値更新に現実味、中立金利や介入効果に注目＝内田稔氏 コラム：9月ＦＯＭＣ、ドットプロット更新で金利見通しに波乱も 10/29(木) 7:45 最終更新 ロイター

FAST

Oct 28 : Alphabet's Google on Wednesday unveiled Gemini 4 Carbon, its latest frontier AI model, stepping up competition with OpenAI and Anthropic as the race to build more capable coding and cybersecurity systems intensifies. The launch comes two weeks after Google introduced Gemini 4 Argon, as the company expands its Gemini family of AI models for developers and enterprise customers. Here are some details: • The company said the Carbon model delivers state-of-the-art performance across cybersecurity tasks including vulnerability discovery, exploitation, and software patching

item.description:
Maria Cheng Andrew Gray
[オタワ／ブリュッセル ２８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Maria Cheng　Andrew Gray

[オタワ／ブリュッセル　２８日　ロイター] - カナダを欧州連合（ＥＵ）初の「準加盟国」として受け入れる構想について、３０日から開かれるＥＵ・カナダ首脳会合の共同声明に盛り込まれないことが２８日、ロイターが入手した草案で分かった。

ＥＵ・カナダ首脳会合はカナダのカーニー首相の主催でモントリオールで開幕。関係を一段と緊密化することで合意すると見られているが、声明草案によると、カナダとＥＵの関係を定義する作業は来年のＥＵ・カナダ首脳会合まで継続される。

これまでの共同声明案には、カナダを「準加盟国」と位置付ける表現が少なくとも２カ所盛り込まれており、この用語の定義づけにはさらに１年を要するとの認識も示されていた。ＥＵの「準加盟国」には前例も法的定義も存在しない。

カナダをＥＵの「準加盟国」とする構想については、ＥＵの執行機関である欧州委員会のフォンデアライエン委員長が９月１６日に行った欧州議会での一般教書演説で表明。カーニー首相はその翌日に行った欧州議会での演説で、同構想を歓迎し、米国と中国が支配する世界で市場、民主主義、法の支配を守るため、カナダと欧州が連携を強化すべきだと訴えていた。

ただ、ドイツを中心とする一部加盟国が「準加盟国」という法的地位がなく、内容も具体化されていない構想を受け入れることはできないと主張するなど、ＥＵ・カナダ首脳会合の共同声明を巡りＥＵ加盟国の間で見解の相違が出ていた。

トランプ米大統領がカナダ製品に関税を課す中、カーニー首相は欧州との関係強化を戦略の重要な柱の１つとしている。ただ、カナダのＥＵへの接近はトランプ大統領の反発を招く可能性もある。実際、トランプ大統領はカナダをＥＵの「準加盟国」とする提案を「ばかげている」と非難し、こうした動きを自身が「敵対行為」と見なした場合は、欧州との貿易を多くの分野で停止する可能性があると警告している。

item.title: ‘We think it’s premature’: Expert reaction to the Bank of Canada’s first rate hike since 2023
item.description: The Bank of Canada raised its key interest rate for the first time in more than three years on Wednesday, drawing mixed reaction from experts and lawmakers.
item.dc:creator: Jordan Fleguel
item.content:encoded: The Bank of Canada raised its key interest rate for the first time in more than three years on Wednesday, drawing mixed reaction from experts and lawmakers. The central bank’s governor, Tiff Macklem, said in remarks Wednesday that elevated global energy prices could soon seep into other parts of the Canadian economy, and the hike was needed to reduce that risk. Earl Davis, head of fixed income and money markets at BMO Global Asset Management, told BNN Bloomberg following the bank’s decision that Macklem’s comments suggest the bank is “trying to get ahead of the game.” But a rate hike on its own won’t prevent the knock-on effects of higher oil prices, Davis said. “That will happen no matter what, but it prevents people from buying ahead of time and controlling inflation,” he said. “So (Macklem) is trying to get ahead of it, and that seems to be explicitly stated in the statement.” The bank’s decision to hike comes as Canada’s economy continues to grapple with uncertainty due to shifting geopolitical dynamics and a trading relationship with the U.S. that has fundamentally changed. Canadian workers have paid the price for the country’s economic sluggishness. Statistics Canada said earlier this month that the economy shed a net 68,300 jobs in September, effectively erasing the employment gains made earlier this year. ‘Pre-emptive hike’ Davis said that according to the Bank of Canada’s October Monetary Policy Report, released Wednesday, the bank has put a renewed emphasis on mitigating the impacts of a “persistent supply shock” in energy markets. “In layman’s terms, the persistence of how high oil has been, and the price of oil at this level for so long… will impact inflation expectations of consumers for the next six months to a year, which means they will buy more and consume more now to get ahead of inflation,” he said. “So, we see this hike as a pre-emptive hike.” Davis said the decision didn’t come as a surprise to him, as the 25-basis-point increase was widely expected, but he added that the move was likely made too early. “Why we think it’s premature is… last week we had a lot of equity volatility, a lot of risk of market nervousness, which has calmed down this week, but we expect that volatility to return and remain there for the fourth quarter, which adds to uncertainty,” he explained. RSM Canada economist Tu Nguyen said in an emailed statement to BNN Bloomberg that the bank’s “decidedly hawkish” tone sends a clear message. “This is the first hike in a hiking cycle. Expect the next rate hike as early as December – with more to follow in 2027,” she said. “The Bank of Canada won’t be alone in raising rates. Rather, it’s set to be one of several major central banks embarking on a hiking cycle… ahead of tightening global financial conditions in 2027 that could thwart growth.” ‘Silver lining’ Wednesday’s rate hike also comes at a time when many Canadians are struggling with the overall cost of living, and higher interest rates will be an additional challenge, said Ontario Premier Doug Ford in a post to X on Wednesday. “Higher rates won’t get oil moving through the Strait of Hormuz or lower tariffs on Canadian businesses,” he wrote. “They will only make life more expensive for Canadian families and workers, punishing them for something they can’t control.” Davis said that while the Bank of Canada may have moved into a hiking cycle too early, the decision may ultimately have “a silver lining.” “It may very well be the right thing in hindsight, but because it’s premature, the market was, prior to this, discounting an additional 100-basis-points-plus of hikes, including today’s,” he said. “We think that will be reduced now to possibly 75, or the market thinking the Bank of Canada will hike less over the coming year because today was a bit premature.” With files from CP24’s Phil Tsekouras and The Canadian Press

Possible new dwarf planet identified orbiting beyond Pluto

This image shows the orbital pathway of the newly discovered dwarf planet candidate 2026 ED138, as observed by the US National Science Foundation/Department of Energy Vera C. Rubin Observatory. This image is a composite of multiple images captured by Rubin between March 4 and July 11, 2026, at intervals indicated by the teal-colored circles. ED138 is visible at the center of each circle. NSF–DOE Vera C. Rubin Observatory/NOIRLab/SLAC/AURA/Handout via REUTERS

FAST

WASHINGTON, Oct 28 : Scientists using a Chile-based telescope have identified an icy object orbiting beyond Pluto that may join our solar system's small roster of dwarf planets. Researchers said the candidate, named 2026 ED138, has a diameter estimated at between roughly 370 and 930 miles (600 and 1,500 km) and is orbiting about 46 times farther from the sun than Earth. By way of comparison, Pluto orbits at an average of about 40 times farther from the sun than Earth. The object was spotted using the new Vera C. Rubin Observatory, on the summit of the Cerro Pachón mountain in central Chile. The telescope is a joint initiative of the US National Science Foundation and US Department of Energy. Further observations are needed to confirm that the object is a dwarf planet.

If confirmed, 2026 ED138 would join five other dwarf planets recognized by the International Astronomical Union, the global authority on classifying celestial bodies. Those are Pluto, Eris, Haumea and Makemake, all of which orbit beyond the outermost planet Neptune, and Ceres, located in the main asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter. Based on the current data, 2026 ED138 would be among the largest of the dwarf planets. "For me, what this demonstrates is that many exciting discoveries remain to be made with the Rubin Observatory and other telescopes," said astrophysicist Matt Holman of the Center for Astrophysics, Harvard & Smithsonian, who first spotted 2026 ED138. Pluto long was considered the solar system's ninth and outermost planet, but was reclassified by the International Astronomical Union as a dwarf planet in 2006 because it did not meet the organization's formal definition of a planet. Pluto and the new dwarf planet candidate reside in a frigid region of the solar system populated by various icy bodies. There are still questions about the size and composition of 2026 ED138. To be considered a dwarf planet, an object must possess sufficient mass for its own gravity to pull it into a round shape. 2026 ED138 appears to have sufficient mass for that, but more observations are needed. "The main thing we need to do is to establish the physical size of 2026 ED138," Holman said. "When we observe with Rubin, we are seeing the sun's light reflected from the object," Holman said. "A smaller, more reflective object would show the same amount of light as a larger, less reflective object. Fortunately, by looking at longer wavelengths, with an observatory like ALMA, we can detect the light emitted by the object itself," which is helpful in measuring an object's size. ALMA, or the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array, is a powerful telescope also based in Chile. The discovery was announced at a scientific meeting in Spokane, Washington.

Source: Reuters

(Corrects paragraph 2 to reflect that NVision has raised $120 million from public and private sources, not $155 million) By Stephen Nellis SAN FRANCISCO, Oct 28 : German startup NVision on Wednesday published a paper in the scientific journal Nature showing a new way to make quantum computing chips that would borrow from the widespread manufacturing techniques currently used in smartphone displays. Startups and tech giants such as Microsoft and IBM alike are racing to build quantum computers that hold the promise of solving problems that would take conventional machines thousands of years. But NVision, which has raised $120 million in funding from public and private sources such as Abbott Laboratories, made the discovery published on Wednesday while working in an entirely different field: improving medical devices.

The company had developed a machine that can zap special sugar molecules until the spin of their electrons aligned. The aligned spins make the sugars a thousand times easier for MRI machines to see, which in turn helps identify cancer cells that eat the sugars far faster than healthy cells. In the research published Wednesday, NVision showed that its technology can also work on organic molecules similar to those used in organic light-emitting diode (OLED) displays widely used in the electronics business. NVision used AI to simulate hundreds of candidate molecules and then physically synthesized about 40 of them until it found one that could be laid down in a thin layer over a chip made with conventional technology to create a quantum chip.  "We found this 'Goldilocks' molecule," Ilai Schwartz, NVision's chief technology officer, told Reuters in an interview. NVision also said on Wednesday that it is partnering with US-based chipmaker HyperLight to make its first chips. NVision CEO Sella Brosh said that the company plans to build an entire quantum computer rather than sell only its specialized molecules. "We want to do the whole thing, to fabricate the chips, to deposit the molecules, to do all the error correction on top of it," Brosh said in an interview. "Eventually, what we will sell is a rack-ready computer."

Source: Reuters

FAST

WASHINGTON, Oct 28 : Anthropic told California Governor Gavin Newsom that government officials should be able to seek court orders blocking the release of AI models that pose a "serious risk" to the public, according to an October 15 letter that echoed the company's earlier policy proposals. Anthropic itself has faced government restrictions on its AI systems. The Trump administration in June ordered Anthropic to immediately restrict foreign access to its cyber-capable Mythos 5 and Fable 5 models, citing national security concerns. The US Commerce Department later lifted the order.  "When a review finds a model poses a serious risk, the government should be able to ask a court to block it," the letter to Newsom said.  An Anthropic spokesperson confirmed the letter is authentic. The California governor's office did not immediately respond to a request for comment.

Anthropic submitted the recommendations after Newsom in September convened a panel of artificial intelligence experts to develop proposals for AI safety requirements. OpenAI on October 20 also sent a list of recommendations to Newsom.  Anthropic, in its letter, also said requirements that developers build "kill switches" capable of shutting down entire AI models in the event a company loses control over their actions could provide a "false sense of reassurance" to government officials. Anthropic supports more targeted interventions, such as disabling a problematic AI agent or cutting off a specific customer's access to a model, according to the letter, saying they would be more effective. Politico first reported the details of the letter.  POSSIBLE LEGISLATIVE ACTIONS A bipartisan group of US senators in September were debating legislation that would give the US government the power to block the release of certain AI models that are deemed unsafe, Reuters reported, and companies would be able to challenge that decision in federal court. Congress left for its pre-election break shortly after, and lawmakers have not moved forward on that proposal.  US House lawmakers in July proposed the "AI Kill Switch Act," which would give US officials the power to order AI firms to shut down models that put human life or the economy at risk.  Anthropic is preparing for a US initial public offering. The listing would represent one of the most consequential stock market debuts in years, potentially reshaping benchmark indexes, investor flows and the broader narrative driving US equities.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Jio IPO windfall brings mega party, early salaries, and bonus bonanza
item.description: The accelerated bonus payment brought forward a substantial portion of employees' annual performance-linked rewards ...
item.dc:creator: Press Trust of India
item.content:encoded: Asia's richest man, Mukesh Ambani, is known for throwing lavish weddings for his children. On Wednesday, he brought that trademark scale of celebration to a corporate milestone, hosting a mega party for thousands of employees at Reliance Corporate Park to mark the blockbuster stock market debut of Jio Platforms Ltd.The celebrations extended beyond the party: October salaries have been paid early on October 15, and 75 per cent of employees' annual cash bonus or performance-linked incentive for the 2026-27 fiscal year was disbursed on Wednesday, months ahead of the usual post-financial-year payout.Thousands of employees and their families gathered at Reliance Corporate Park in the afternoon to celebrate the listing of the digital and telecommunications business, which raised a record Rs 30,213 crore in its initial public offering and thereafter saw a bumper listing on Wednesday.Dozens of food stalls serving street food, dance performances and jam sessions blending devotional music with contemporary rhythms enthralled thousands who gathered on invitations by Ambani's scions, sources privy to the matter said.While October salary was paid a fortnight early on October 15 to enable employees bid for shares offered in the IPO, the bonus payment was brought forward to bring early Diwali, they said.The accelerated bonus payment brought forward a substantial portion of employees' annual performance-linked rewards.Akash Ambani, chairman of Reliance Jio and managing director of Jio Platforms, swapped the bandhgala and business suits he had worn for investor roadshows and the listing ceremony for a T-shirt as he addressed employees at the celebratory gala. His siblings - twin sister Isha and younger brother Anant - who had stood alongside him at key moments in the run-up to the IPO, were by his side once again.The listing marked a defining moment for Ambani's strategy to transform Reliance from an energy-focused conglomerate into a major player in telecommunications and digital services. Jio, which disrupted India's telecom market with low-cost data and voice services, has grown into a platform serving more than 540 million customers.Mukesh Ambani, who built Jio into one of India's largest telecom and digital platforms, largely ceded the spotlight to the next generation during the IPO, allowing his eldest son Akash to take the lead through investor roadshows and the listing process.While Ambani remained the architect of Reliance's larger vision, his relative absence from the public-facing campaign marked a carefully choreographed generational transition, with Akash emerging as the principal voice of Jio's ambitions before investors.His father's imprint, however, was unmistakable - in a record-breaking share sale that capped a decade of investment in building India's digital infrastructure.The festivities also extend beyond the workplace. Reliance is also organising religious ceremonies, special prayers and bhandaras - community meals offered to devotees - at prominent temples and pilgrimage centres across the country to mark Jio's listing.The planned initiatives span Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh, Maharashtra, Kerala, Assam, West Bengal, Rajasthan and Odisha, combining traditional rituals with large-scale food distribution for pilgrims and local communities, they said.In Uttar Pradesh, special shringar and bhog rituals are planned at the Shri Kashi Vishwanath Temple in Varanasi, alongside a community feast for 15,000 devotees on October 29. At the Shree Annapurna Mandir, also in Varanasi, the planned feast is expected to serve 32,000 people, including 200 sadhus and sanyasis. A community lunch for 500 visitors is planned at Kanpur's Baba Anandeshwar Mandir.In Uttarakhand, food-distribution arrangements and bhandara services are planned at the Badrinath and Kedarnath temples for pilgrims and local communities. Parmarth Niketan Ashram in Rishikesh and Siddhpeeth Shri Dakshin Kali Mandir in Haridwar are also among the locations where special religious services and community meals are planned.In Mumbai, day-long community-feeding operations are planned at the Siddhivinayak, Mumba Devi, Babulnath and Mahalaxmi temples. At the Shree Mookambika Devi Mandir in Ghansoli, a 15-member bhajan group is scheduled to perform as part of a programme that includes a community feast for 5,000 devotees, sources said.The initiatives also include the Shirdi Sai Baba Temple, where festive lighting and floral decorations are planned alongside a contribution towards the temple's daily community kitchen, which serves an estimated 1,00,000 people. At Trimbakeshwar Jyotirlinga Mandir, the programme includes meals for 1,000 pilgrims, devotional music and offerings to 200 sadhus.In Kerala, special community meals and offerings are planned at the Sri Rajarajeswara Temple in Kannur. Other locations listed for celebrations include Kamakhya Temple in Assam, Kalighat Temple in Kolkata, Salasar Balaji Mandir in Rajasthan, Jagannath Temple in Puri and Shreenathji Temple in Nathdwara, with programmes featuring prayers, devotional music, floral decorations and community dining.The nationwide religious initiatives give the listing a distinctly Indian celebratory dimension, combining corporate milestones with traditional expressions of gratitude and community service.Jio's market debut itself was a landmark for India's equity market. The Rs 30,213-crore offering was the country's largest initial public offering, surpassing Hyundai Motor India's Rs 27,870-crore issue in 2024.Jio shares opened at Rs 1,358, a premium of 21.4 per cent over the issue price of Rs 1,119, giving the company a strong start as a listed business.The listing marks a new chapter for Reliance's decade-long investment in building Jio into one of the world's largest telecommunications businesses, with a subscriber base exceeding 530 million and ambitions extending into cloud computing, enterprise technology and artificial intelligence.

item.description:
Greg Bensinger

item.content:encoded:
米アマゾン、端末・サービス部門で約250人削減 0:38 配信

2025年2月26日、米国ニューヨーク市で撮影。REUTERS/Brendan McDermid/File Photo（ロイター） Greg Bensinger

[サンフランシスコ ２８日 ロイター] - 米アマゾン・ドット・コムが、端末・サービス部門で約２５０人を削減したことが分かった。同社はロイターに対し、人員削減を認めた。広報担当者は「少数の職務を廃止するという難しい決断を下した」と述べたが、詳細は明らかにしなかった。

事情に詳しい関係者によると、削減対象は最大２５０人で、主にソフトウエア開発に携わる従業員だった。

広報担当者は、人員削減によって「業務の効率を高め、製品開発計画との整合性を向上させる」と説明した。

同社はここ数週間、電子書籍端末「キンドル」やタブレット端末の新製品などを相次いで投入。２８日には、音声アシスタント「アレクサ」を搭載した新たな目覚まし時計とフォトフレームも発表した。

アマゾンは今月に入り、中核の小売部門でも約１０００人を削減している。

item.content:encoded:
[キーウ　２８日　ロイター] - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は２８日、ウクライナ、ロシア、米国の和平交渉担当者による３カ国協議が、１１月６日─１０日にアラブ首長国連邦（ＵＡＥ）のアブダビで開催されることを望んでいると述べた。

ゼレンスキー氏は、戦争終結の方法を巡る協議に欧州が関与することを望んでいると述べ、結束とロシアに対するより強い圧力が必要だと訴えた。

一方、ロシアのウシャコフ大統領補佐官（外交担当）は、ウクライナ紛争の解決を巡る次回の３カ国協議に欧州の代表は参加しないと述べた。インタファクス通信が伝えた。

ウシャコフ氏は、プーチン大統領が２７日にフィンランドのストゥブ大統領、ノルウェーのストーレ首相と行った電話会談では、欧州諸国の交渉への参加の可能性は議論されなかったと言及。

来月アブダビで開催される見通しの協議の日程については、まだ合意されていないと述べた。

AMSTERDAM, Oct 28 (Reuters) – The Netherlands will supply Ukraine with €500 million ($556 million) in military support this winter, Dutch Prime Minister Rob Jetten said on Wednesday.

The support will be used to supply drones and other material to strengthen Ukraine’s defence, he said after a meeting with Ukraine’s President Volodymyr Zelenskiy in The Hague.

Earlier on Wednesday, ahead of Zelenskiy’s visit, the Dutch government announced it would give Ukraine €1.2 billion in non-military support in the next three years.

Show Full Article

The government pledged €380 million to help reconstruction in Ukraine next year and around €410 million in both 2028 and 2029.

Part of the money will be used for funds that support Dutch companies willing to invest in the rebuilding of Ukraine, the government said.

Other support is intended for urgent repairs of Ukraine’s energy infrastructure and the supply of machines to Ukrainian industry.

($1 = 0.8993 euros)

(Reporting by Bart Meijer Editing by William Maclean and Keith Weir)

Prediction market bets set the tone for Anthropic's much-awaited IPO

FAST

Oct 28 : Prediction markets are seeing massive trades for Anthropic contracts after the AI giant's IPO filing, even as retail stock traders await the official opening bell likely next month. The binary "yes" or "no" bets in prediction markets are influencing the way retail investors speculate on high-profile IPOs, allowing traders to wager on aspects such as the closing prices and its listing venue without the need to buy shares. "Prediction market interest in Anthropic's IPO is the financial equivalent of people lining up outside the Apple Store before a new iPhone release," said Michael Ashley Schulman, a partner at wealth management and financial advisory firm Cerity Partners. Earlier this week, Anthropic took a major step toward going public by unveiling its IPO filing. The listing could value the AI lab behind the Claude models at between $1.5 trillion and $2 trillion, Reuters has reported.

On Polymarket, more than a dozen markets have sprung up around the IPO, where traders are placing bets on its fundraising haul, listing exchange and debut valuation. Rival Kalshi is also drawing bets on everything from which bank will lead the offering to which sector index providers will classify Anthropic in. Combined, the markets have attracted tens of millions of dollars in volume. "It is a healthy sign of robust interest and the wagers placed may help the market zero in on its eventual public market opening price," said Schulman. Prediction markets allow users to buy and sell contracts tied to the outcome of real-life events, with prices fluctuating as traders weigh the odds of the different outcomes. Once largely tied to politics and economic data, the platforms are increasingly moving into traditional Wall Street turf, offering tens of thousands of markets on stock moves, company data and other corporate events that often drive shares, Reuters reported last month. IPO investing, however, has long been dominated by deep-pocketed institutional investors. Although retail participation has expanded in recent years, including around Elon Musk's SpaceX listing, issuers still allocate only a small portion of offerings to individual investors. "The Anthropic IPO is going to be a crucial litmus test about both individual and institutional investors' appetite for AI," said Steve Sosnick, chief strategist at Interactive Brokers. The Polymarket contract on the timing of Anthropic's IPO had drawn $6 million in trading volume as of 9:30 a.m. ET (1330 GMT) on October 28. A separate market on the AI company's closing market capitalization had attracted about $3 million. "Prediction markets are clearly becoming an integral part of many investors' approach to financial risk management and speculation," Sosnick said.

Source: Reuters

FAST

SAN FRANCISCO, Oct 28 : Amazon cut about 250 jobs on Wednesday in its devices and services unit after weeks of product rollouts including new Kindle e-readers and tablet computers. The company confirmed the cuts after a Reuters inquiry. "We've made the difficult decision to eliminate a small number of roles," a spokesperson said without elaborating. The cuts affected no more than 250 jobs, said a person familiar with the matter, primarily in software development.  The layoffs will help the company "operate more efficiently and better align with our product roadmap," the spokesperson said. Amazon on Wednesday also announced a new Alexa-powered alarm clock and photo frame. As is the company's custom, text messages and emails were sent to workers early Wednesday morning. One seen by Reuters was from Cherie Robinson, a human resources vice president in devices and services, saying the company had undergone "a thorough review of our structure" resulting in the need for cuts. Earlier this month, Amazon pared about 1,000 jobs in its core retail division. The company reports its third-quarter earnings after the market close on Thursday.

Source: Reuters

BRUSSELS, Oct 28 : Belgium's Federal Public Service Finance said on Wednesday that a cyberattack had hit its digital services, forcing the temporary shutdown of the country's online tax portal and several other services. The agency said there were no indications of a data breach or that any data had been stolen, but added that the matter was being closely investigated. • Tax-filing deadlines will be extended as a result of the disruption, the agency said, adding that a specific new date would follow as soon as possible. • The precautionary shutdown of services is intended to limit risks and allow technical work to secure the agency's systems, it said. • A large portion of the agency's other applications remain available with full or partial functionality, it said.

item.title: 米9月モノの貿易赤字、25年3月以来の大きさ 輸入が過去最高
item.description: [ワシントン ２８日 ロイター] - 米商務省が２８日発表した９月の財（モノ）の貿易赤字（季節調整済み）は前月比２．１...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米9月モノの貿易赤字、25年3月以来の大きさ　輸入が過去最高 10/28 23:39 配信

米カリフォルニア州ロングビーチ港沖に停泊するコンテナ船。７月撮影。REUTERS/Mario Anzuoni（ロイター） [ワシントン ２８日 ロイター] - 米商務省が２８日発表した９月の財（モノ）の貿易赤字（季節調整済み）は前月比２．１％（２８億ドル）増の１３４９億ドルと、２０２５年３月以来の大きさとなった。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連インフラの拡充に伴う資本財の旺盛な需要を背景に、輸入が過去最高に急増した。第３・四半期も貿易が経済成長の押し下げ要因となったことを示唆している。

ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想の赤字額は１３０２億ドルだった。

９月のモノの輸入は２．４％（８１億ドル）増の３４４１億ドル。資本財が７．５％急増したことが押し上げ要因となった。資本財の輸入は前年同月比で７７．２％と急増した。消費財の輸入は３．１％増加した。その他のモノの輸入は６．７％増えた。一方、金や石油を含む工業用資材の輸入は６．０％減少した。食品と自動車の輸入も減少した。

モノの輸出は２．６％（５３億ドル）増の２０９２億ドル。食品の輸出が１２．８％急増した。資本財は５．４％、消費財は６．５％、それぞれ増加した。一方、自動車と工業用資材の輸出は減少した。

卸売在庫は０．６％増加した。小売業者の在庫は０．３％増加、自動車・部品在庫は０．２％増えた。

自動車・部品を除く小売在庫は０．４％増加。前月は０．１％増だった。この項目は国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）の算出に用いられる。

２６年第３・四半期のＧＤＰ速報値は２９日発表の予定で、ロイターがまとめた予想は年率換算で前期比３．２％増。ＡＩ関連投資や個人消費などがけん引し、第２・四半期の２．２％増から伸び率が加速するとみられている。なお、貿易は３四半期連続でＧＤＰのプラスに寄与していない。

ネーションワイドのエコノミスト、ダニエル・フィールハーバー氏は「貿易は四半期のＧＤＰを押し下げるが、これは企業の設備投資の継続と個人消費の勢いを示すものであり、米国経済にとって弱さではなく強さの表れだ」と述べた。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：米移民摘発、過去最高の逮捕件数も送還難航　法的手続きや移送能力に壁 コラム：米財務省の借入拡大、債務問題の大きさに比べれば単なるノイズ 焦点：テスラ、ロボタクシー「サイバーキャブ」で試す規制の限界 コラム：日銀利上げの「美しいシナリオ」に弱点はないか＝上野泰也氏 コラム：日米協調介入が告げる円高への転換、円安派は今こそ見直しの時 10/29(木) 0:08 最終更新 ロイター

item.content:encoded:
[モスクワ ２８日 ロイター] - ロシア外務省のザハロワ情報局長は２８日、ラブロフ外相が３０─３１日に米国で開かれる２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）外相会合に出席すると明らかにした。

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[マイアミ ２８日 ロイター] -  ブラジル大統領選で現職のルラ大統領に敗れたフラビオ・ボルソナロ上院議員が２８日、米フロリダ州マイアミに到着したことがロイターの映像で確認された。

ボルソナロ氏は敗北後、連邦最高裁判所のパスポート提出命令に従わずに米国に向けて出国したことが関係筋の話で分かっていた。米国務省は同氏と家族に入国ビザを発給する方針という。

item.title: カナダ中銀、約3年ぶり利上げ エネルギー高巡り追加引き締め示唆
item.description:
Promit Mukherjee David Ljunggren
［オタワ ２８日 ロイター］ - カナダ銀行（中央...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
カナダ中銀、約3年ぶり利上げ　エネルギー高巡り追加引き締め示唆 10/28 23:18 配信

2026年1月28日、カナダ中銀のマックレム総裁。REUTERS/Kyaw Soe Oo/File Photo（ロイター） Promit Mukherjee　David Ljunggren

［オタワ　２８日　ロイター］　 - カナダ銀行（中央銀行）は２８日、政策金利を２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）引き上げて２．５％とした。２０２３年７月以来、約３年ぶりとなる利上げに踏み切った。利上げは市場で広く予想されていた。中銀は、エネルギー価格の急騰が幅広い物価上昇につながるのを防ぐため、追加利上げが必要になる可能性があると指摘した。

マックレム総裁は記者会見の冒頭で「インフレ見通しが大幅に高まり、経済が底堅さを示している中、高止まりするエネルギー価格が波及して一般的なインフレになるリスクを減らすため、政策金利の引き上げが必要だ」と述べた。

今回の利上げは銀行の貸出金利や住宅ローンの負担を押し上げ、経済成長を鈍化させる可能性がある。ただ、マックレム氏は、物価上昇を確実に抑えることを目指していると説明。会見で、政策金利はなおやや緩和的な水準にあるものの、今後数カ月の望ましい金利水準について予断を持たないと述べた。「政策金利をさらに引き上げる必要があるかもしれないが、不確実性が非常に大きいことを十分認識しており、こうした状況であらかじめ決まった政策の道筋はない」と語った。

中銀は２０２７年のインフレ見通しを、７月時点で予想していた２．０％から３．１％に引き上げた。２０２６年の成長率は１．０％になるとし、７月時点の０．７％から上方修正した。９月のインフレ率は前年同月比３．２％となり、中銀の目標範囲である１─３％を上回った。上昇はほぼ全て、エネルギー価格と、それに関連する輸送費の上昇によるものだった。

マックレム氏は、インフレ率は年末時点で３．５％となり、２０２７年の大半で３％前後にとどまった後、２０２８年半ばまでに目標の２％近辺に戻るとの見通しを示した。「政策委員会は、インフレのリスクが高まり、金融緩和の余地が狭まったとの認識で一致した」という。

ただ、今回の利上げ後も、政策金利はなお中立金利を下回っている。中立金利とは、引き締め的でも緩和的でもないとされる金融政策の水準を指す。中銀はその中央値を２．７５％としている。

マックレム氏は、過去の経験と中銀の各種調査から、コストの転嫁は向こう１年で拡大し、全体のインフレを押し上げるとみられるとし、「エネルギー価格の上昇とコスト転嫁が組み合わさることで、インフレの持続性が高まる」と警戒感を示した。ただ、米国との貿易摩擦や中東紛争のより早期の解決といった不確定要素が残っているとも付け加えた。

マックレム氏は、米国の新たな関税が第４・四半期の景気減速につながるとしつつ、消費支出の継続、輸出の持ち直し、企業投資の拡大により、成長は２０２７年に再び加速するはずだと自信を示した。

中銀の最新の金融政策報告書によると、カナダ経済は第２・四半期に年率３．３％という堅調な成長を記録した後、第３・四半期に２％へ減速し、第４・四半期にはさらに０．８％まで鈍化する見通し。

ただ、国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）見通しについては、２７年・２８年いずれも、７月時点で予想した１．８％から２％へ上方修正した。

マックレム氏は、この成長の上積みが、経済における需給の緩みを吸収する一助になると述べた。

ＣＩＢＣキャピタル・マーケッツのアンドルー・グランサム上級エコノミストは「世界的なエネルギー価格を巡る動向が幾分落ち着けば、基調的なインフレ指標が中銀が懸念するほど加速するとは考えていない」とし、「このため、政策金利を２．７５％を超える水準まで引き上げる必要はないとみている」と述べた。

カナダ中銀の次回の政策決定会合は１２月９日。

ロイター 関連リンク コラム：何が豪ドルを動かしているのか＝高島修氏 コラム：円急伸で揺らぐキャリートレード、見つからない次の調達通貨 アングル：ＥＣＢ、金利据え置きへ　原油価格が再び焦点 コラム：ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長が問う見通しのあり方、3つの論点＝井上哲也氏 アングル：世界的な中銀の金融引き締め姿勢、米イラン合意でも潮目変わらず 10/29(木) 1:11 最終更新 ロイター

AI giants' funding ambitions test Wall Street's appetite for risk

FILE PHOTO: FILE PHOTO: A street sign for Wall Street is seen outside the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) in New York City, New York, U.S., July 19, 2021. REUTERS/Andrew Kelly/File Photo/File Photo

FILE PHOTO: Anthropic logo and a keyboard in this illustration taken October 19, 2026. REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo

FAST

Oct 28 : The heavyweights of the AI industry are facing a reckoning on Wall Street, reflecting concerns over who will bear the cost of the artificial intelligence buildout that has fueled much of this year's stock market gains. Anthropic revealed paperwork for its initial public offering on Monday, paving the way for a share sale reportedly worth $100 billion as early as next month. Meta also unveiled a plan this week that could bring it as much as $97.5 billion through equity offerings over the coming months. The markets will also await signs of fundraising plans when Microsoft and Alphabet report earnings later on Wednesday.

By pressing ahead with their enormous funding plans, the biggest AI players are wagering that investors' fear of missing out on future returns will outweigh their fear of overpaying for them. AI stocks accounted for nearly 75 per cent of the S&P 500 index's return in the first half of 2026, according to an analysis by Carson Group. "The growth of the AI ecosystem over the last several years is quite astounding," said Ehren Stanhope, chief investment strategist at Franklin Templeton's Canvas. "The idea that such large firms can compound earnings at triple digits for multiple years seems to defy the laws of economics." But Wall Street's reaction in recent weeks suggests ambition is no longer enough to get investors to open their wallets. Meta's shares have fallen more than 11 per cent since it unveiled plans last week to create a new class of stock to fund share sales and reported its first quarterly cash burn in more than a decade. While Anthropic's soaring revenue helped ease AI growth concerns, its mounting losses have raised fresh questions. The company's net loss widened to $80.7 billion in the first half of 2026 from $13 billion a year earlier. "Not even Anthropic will get a blank check," said Matt Kennedy, senior strategist at Renaissance Capital. The funding demands are coming amid growing circular financing arrangements, in which money invested in AI companies can flow back to their investors through spending on computing infrastructure and services. SMALLER FIRMS FEEL THE HEAT Companies that are relatively small but carry heavy debt are in a more bleak position. CoreWeave has seen its bond yields soar, raising questions about how much it would have to pay in interest when it raises debt next. "The danger (for CoreWeave) is the next loan. And how soon CoreWeave needs it matters as much as the price," said Matthew Tuttle, founder and CEO of Tuttle Capital Management. Last week, CoreWeave's shares hit their lowest since May 2025 as concerns about its reliance on debt grew. The stock has rebounded around 10 per cent so far this week, but "a company surviving and its old shareholders winning are two different outcomes," Tuttle added. SpaceX CEO Elon Musk recently said neocloud companies could face significant consolidation and failures. He ruled out any acquisition of a neocloud company by SpaceX, saying such a deal would be "pointless." Still, this year's AI capex by Amazon, Alphabet, Meta, Oracle and Microsoft would likely equal their cumulative spend since the November 2022 launch of ChatGPT, according to data from J.P. Morgan. "In effect, the Street appears to be underwriting the AI data center monetization case," wrote Dubravko Lakos-Bujas, the brokerage's head of global markets strategy.

Source: Reuters

Oct 28 : Cloud security startup Upwind on Wednesday said it raised $400 million in a funding round led by Bessemer Venture Partners, valuing it at $3.8 billion. Here are some more details: • The startup was valued at about $900 million in a December 2024 raise of $100 million; its $250 million Series B funding nine months ago came without a disclosed valuation • The latest round, which will fund product expansion, brings the company's total funding to over $800 million since its founding in 2022 • Existing investors including Greylock Partners, Cyberstarts, Craft Ventures, Salesforce Ventures, Alta Park and TCV also participated, while Canapi Ventures joined as a new backer

Source: Reuters

SAP uses more than 70 AI models from providers including OpenAI, Anthropic and Google. Asam said the company increasingly chooses the cheapest model capable of performing a task to the required standard, while still expecting overall spending on AI to rise as adoption grows. "The goal is healthy margins as scale grows, not an absolute reduction in AI expenditure," SAP said in answers to Reuters questions. Unlike many AI providers, SAP charges customers for completed tasks rather than for the underlying computing resources used to generate responses, meaning lower operating costs can help improve profitability. Customers are also paying closer attention to where AI models come from. Asam said government agencies and companies in regulated industries increasingly ask specific requirements and exclude models based on origin, while European customers increasingly demand local solutions.

Source: Reuters

item.description: エヌビディアのハギングフェイス買収、米司法省が競争影響調査＝関係筋 Reuters

item.title: エヌビディアのハギングフェイス買収、米司法省が競争影響調査＝関係筋
item.description:
Max A. Cherney Jeffrey Dastin Jody Godoy
[サンフランシスコ ２８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Max A. Cherney　Jeffrey Dastin　Jody Godoy

[サンフランシスコ ２８日 ロイター] - 米司法省は、米半導体設計大手エヌビディアが人工知能（ＡＩ）新興企業ハギングフェイスを１２９億３０００万ドルで買収する計画について、ＡＩ分野の競争に及ぼす影響を聞き取りを行った。事情に詳しい関係者２人が明らかにした。反トラスト法（独占禁止法）当局は、エヌビディアの事業慣行を巡り数年来続けている調査を進めている。

ハギングフェイスは、開発者などの利用者が自由にダウンロードやカスタマイズできるオープン型のＡＩモデルを共有するプラットフォームを運営している。

関係者２人によると、司法省による最近の聞き取りは、エヌビディアの買収や投資、販売慣行のほか、顧客に圧力をかけたかどうかを対象としている。司法省当局者は、ハギングフェイスの買収により、エヌビディアがＡＩの流通を支える重要な拠点を掌握できるようになるかを尋ねたという。

エヌビディアは、買収が２０２７年上半期に完了する見通しで、ハギングフェイスは引き続き幅広い半導体、クラウド、ＡＩの各事業者との連携を支援するとしている。

ハギングフェイス買収を巡る司法省の聞き取りと、エヌビディアに対する調査継続の詳細が明らかになるのは今回が初めて。エヌビディアは、アンソロピックやオープンＡＩなど主要企業に出資する一方、ＡＩの膨大な計算需要を自社の半導体で支えるため、世界各地でデータセンター開発を促し、テクノロジー経済とＡＩブームの中核を担う存在となっている。

司法省が何らかの措置を取れば、半導体業界に影響が広がり、ＡＩ分野での影響力を拡大してきたエヌビディアの投資・買収戦略が揺さぶられる可能性がある。政府による調査は不正行為の証拠ではなく、必ずしも提訴につながるわけではない。

エヌビディアはコメントを控えた。司法省とハギングフェイスの担当者は、コメント要請に直ちに応じなかった。

一連の調査は民主党のバイデン前大統領の政権下で始まり、共和党のトランプ米大統領の政権下でも続いている。この間、エヌビディアは時価総額で世界最大の企業となり、ＡＩ分野で突出した存在となった。トランプ氏が調査に関与していることを示す情報はなく、調査が司法省による何らかの措置につながらない可能性もある。

関係者の１人によると、司法省は調査の一環として、エヌビディアによるスケジＭＤの買収も調べている。２０２５年１２月の買収を受け、ＡＩの専門家の間では、国家安全保障に関わるスーパーコンピューターの運用を支えるスケジＭＤのオープンソースソフトウエアを引き続き利用できるか、懸念が浮上した。エヌビディアは、誰でも利用できる状態とサポートを維持すると約束している。

関係者によると、ハギングフェイスの買収計画を巡る聞き取りでは、エヌビディアが同社のＡＩプラットフォームをどのように利用してＡＩ市場の競合に不利益を与え得るかや、買収した事業を交渉力の強化に利用できるかなどを確認している。

当局者はハギングフェイスの競合企業についても質問しているという。

Drones hit container ship off Bulgaria, crew safe and ashore

Reuters

28 October, 2026 07:30 pm IST

Facebook

Follow Us :

Text Size: A- A+

-->

Reuters, Oct 28 (Reuters) – Sea drones struck a container ship off Bulgaria’s Black Sea coast on Wednesday, the ship’s owner and the government said, the latest in a string of attacks that have raised concerns about the growing scope of Russia’s war in Ukraine.

It was not clear who carried out the attack on the Greek ship that was sailing under the Liberian flag in Bulgaria’s exclusive economic zone (EEZ), or what the vessel’s 421 containers were carrying.

“A container ship was hit…with three naval drones, approximately 21 miles southeast of Shabla,” Defence Minister Dimitar Stoyanov told reporters on the sidelines of a regional security meeting.

Show Full Article

Bulgaria’s transport ministry said in a statement that four naval and police boats had been dispatched to assist the vessel, which was travelling from the Israeli port of Haifa to Constanța in Romania, and that the 18 crew members had been evacuated.

The ship’s owner, Contships Management, confirmed the attack and a company official said all the crew of 14 Filippinos and 4 Ukrainians, were safe and ashore.

A maritime security source with knowledge of the matter said the ship had been badly damaged and was listing.

INTERNATIONAL CONCERN

Drone attacks on merchant ships off Bulgaria have likely killed some two dozen international seafarers in recent weeks, according to government statements on missing crew members. At least six merchant vessels have been attacked.

The strikes have been in Bulgaria’s exclusive economic zone, an area that stretches beyond Bulgaria’s waters but where the country holds sole rights to explore and manage resources.

The attacks have prompted international condemnation and concern about the growing reach of the war in Ukraine. Bulgaria, a member of the European Union and NATO, has sought allied assistance to bolster maritime security.

Ukraine has blamed the attacks on Russia and Bulgarian Prime Minister Rumen Radev has said the attacks appear to benefit Russia, but Moscow has denied involvement.

In a sign of the international concern, Turkish Defence Minister Yasar Guler warned Russia and Ukraine on Wednesday against carrying out attacks on commercial vessels in the Black Sea. He said Ankara reserved the right to take legal action against the strikes.

(Reporting by Aleksandar Vasovic, Stoyan Nenov and Renee Maltezou’; Editing by Kirsten Donovan, Edward McAllister and Timothy Heritage)

item.title: イエメンのフーシ派がアデン空港攻撃、事前に退避警告＝政府当局者 - Reuters
item.description: イエメンのフーシ派がアデン空港攻撃、事前に退避警告＝政府当局者 Reuters

item.title: イエメンのフーシ派がアデン空港攻撃、事前に退避警告＝政府当局者
item.description: [アデン／ドバイ ２８日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[アデン／ドバイ ２８日 ロイター] - イエメン政府当局者は、親イラン武装組織フーシ派が２８日、アデン空港を攻撃したと明らかにした。フーシ派はこれに先立ち、空港から退避するよう警告していた。中東の紛争に巻き込まれたイエメンでは戦闘が激化している。

運輸省当局者２人がロイターに語ったところによると、攻撃後に航空交通は停止された。ある関係筋によると、国連職員の一部が攻撃の直前に空港から退避しており、負傷者はいなかったという。

フーシ派のヤヒヤ・サリーア報道官はＸへの投稿で、サウジ軍の武器輸送機が存在していたことから退避警告を出したと説明した。

サウジ当局から直ちにコメントは得られなかった。

国連の国際移住機関（ＩＯＭ）は、アデンでの攻撃の報告後、同機関の職員の無事が確認されたと発表した。

イエメン首都サヌアと同国北西部の大半を支配するフーシ派は、これまで繰り返しアデン空港を標的にしてきた。住民によると、警告が出される前にも市内の他の場所で爆発音が聞こえたという。

item.title: US stocks today: US stocks turn choppy as megacaps offset chip gains before Fed meet
item.description: In the US stock market, a mixed performance emerged as chipmakers like Micron Technology surged, buoyed by favorable reports from SK Hynix, while major tech players such as Tesla and Apple faced declines. Investors eye the Federal Reserve's imminent interest rate decision and important earnings announcements from Microsoft and Alphabet. The Nasdaq showed positive momentum this week, rising around 2%, reflecting growing optimism surrounding artificial intelligence.
item.dc:creator: ETMarkets.com
item.content:encoded: US stocks traded in a narrow range on Wednesday as gains in chipmakers following strong results from South Korea's SK Hynix were offset by declines in heavyweight technology stocks, with investors awaiting the Federal Reserve's interest rate decision and key earnings from Microsoft and Alphabet, Reuters reported.At 10:01 a.m. ET, the Dow Jones Industrial Average was up 73.40 points, or 0.14%, at 52,450.97. The S&P 500 gained 0.09% to 7,729.20, while the Nasdaq Composite slipped 0.03% to 26,470.68, according to Reuters. For live updates on US Markets, click here Chip stocks rally on SK Hynix resultsMemory chipmaker Micron Technology rose 4.8% to its highest level in more than two weeks after SK Hynix reported a more than sevenfold jump in quarterly profit. SK Hynix's US listed shares surged 10.6%, while the Philadelphia semiconductor index gained 0.9%, putting it on track for a fourth straight session of gains, Reuters said.The strength in chips was partly offset by losses in megacaps. Tesla fell 1.9% after gaining more than 9% over the previous two sessions, while Apple slipped 0.6%. SpaceX dropped 3.2%.Alphabet rose 1.2% after a media report said OpenAI plans to buy Google's AI chips.Fed, AI spending and hyperscaler earnings in focusThe Nasdaq has gained about 2% this week as sentiment around artificial intelligence improved following Anthropic's US IPO filing on Monday. Attention now turns to Microsoft and Alphabet, which are due to report quarterly results after the closing bell, Reuters reported.Investors are expected to focus on cloud growth and capital spending, particularly whether heavy AI investments are generating sufficient returns. Concerns over debt funded AI spending remain a drag on sentiment as borrowing costs rise. We can still see that the AI demand has not paused... the number one worry for investors is not AI valuations anymore, but it's the financing through debt as debt goes through the roof in the US, said Nadia El Bilassy, senior market analyst at Equiti Group.The Fed's policy announcement is due at 2 p.m. ET, with markets broadly expecting a pause after last month's hike. Investors are likely to focus on Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's comments and the policy outlook, Reuters reported. (Disclaimer: This article is based on inputs from agencies. These do not represent the views of The Economic Times)

item.title: コモディティー価格、中東戦争などで今年23％上昇へ＝世銀予測
item.description:
Andrea Shalal
[ワシントン ２８日 ロイター] - 世界銀行は２８日、世界的に２０２６年のコモディティー...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
コモディティー価格、中東戦争などで今年23％上昇へ＝世銀予測 10/28 22:37 配信

カザフスタン・アティラウ州にある石油ポンプ。4月20日撮影。REUTERS/Pavel Mikheyev（ロイター） Andrea Shalal

[ワシントン ２８日 ロイター] - 世界銀行は２８日、世界的に２０２６年のコモディティー（商品）価格が２３％上昇する見込みだと発表した。その理由として、エネルギー価格の上昇、中東戦争中の貨物輸送の混乱、黒海における穀物輸送の問題、金などの安全資産に対する高い需要を挙げている。

最新の「一次産品市場の見通し」で、世界的なショックが重なり、石油、天然ガス、食料、金属の価格が今年に入って急騰したと指摘。また、中東紛争が激化し、ロシアの石油インフラへの被害が続けば、状況はさらに悪化する可能性があると述べた。

来年の商品価格は７％下落すると予想されるものの、１９５０年以来最悪のエルニーニョ現象予測など、継続的なショックによって食料コモディティー価格は高止まりし、インフレ率の上昇や金融引き締め政策を巡る懸念が高まる可能性があるとしている。

世界経済は現時点で、将来の供給ショックに対してより脆弱になっている。世銀は、中東戦争で世界の石油在庫は枯渇しており、世界の石油供給量は２０２６年には５．２％減少すると予想されていると指摘。これは２０年の世界的な景気後退を除けば、過去４０年間で最大の減少幅という。

世銀の副チーフエコノミスト、アイハン・コーゼ氏は「商品市場は複数の大きなショックに同時に見舞われている」と指摘。「エネルギーコストの上昇と貿易の混乱により、幅広い商品価格が上昇しており、インフレ、食料不安、経済成長の悪化を招く恐れがある」と述べた。

item.title: World Bank sees commodity prices up 23% in 2026 due to Middle East war, other shocks
item.description: WASHINGTON, Oct 28 : Global commodity prices are set to surge 23 per cent in 2026, the World Bank said on Wednesday, citing rising energy prices and disruptions to cargo shipping during the Middle East war, grain shipment problems in the Black Sea and high demand for safe-haven assets such as gold.Oil, natura

World Bank sees commodity prices up 23% in 2026 due to Middle East war, other shocks

Birds fly over pump jacks at the Airankol oil field operated by Caspiy Neft in the Atyrau region, Kazakhstan, April 20, 2026. REUTERS/Pavel Mikheyev

FAST

WASHINGTON, Oct 28 : Global commodity prices are set to surge 23 per cent in 2026, the World Bank said on Wednesday, citing rising energy prices and disruptions to cargo shipping during the Middle East war, grain shipment problems in the Black Sea and high demand for safe-haven assets such as gold. Oil, natural gas, food and metals prices all rose sharply this year as global shocks mounted, the World Bank said in its latest Commodity Markets Outlook. It said the situation could worsen if the conflict in the Middle East ratcheted up and damage to Russian oil infrastructure continued. Commodity prices were expected to ease by 7 per cent next year, it said, but continued shocks - including forecasts for the worst El Niño weather effect since 1950 - could keep food commodity prices elevated, raising the specter of higher inflation and tighter monetary policy. The global economy was more vulnerable to future supply shocks at the moment. Global oil stocks have been depleted during the war in the Middle East, and global oil supply is expected to drop 5.2 per cent in 2026, the biggest drop in four decades outside the 2020 global recession, the bank said.

"Commodity markets are being hit by several major shocks at once," said Ayhan Kose, the World Bank’s deputy chief economist. "Higher energy costs and trade disruptions are driving up prices across a broad range of commodities, threatening to worsen inflation, food insecurity, and economic growth." The bank released its twice-yearly report on Wednesday, two days before foreign ministers from the world's 20 largest economies are due to gather in Atlanta, Georgia for a meeting that will focus on the wars in the Middle East and Ukraine. Kose said the World Bank was focused on protecting the world's poorest people and supporting low-income countries already grappling with heavy debt burdens. The bank had already provided $8.7 billion in low-cost loans and other aid to 25 countries affected negatively by the war in the Middle East, the report said. This included 10 countries that retooled existing programs to cover crisis-related expenses, and 19 that had tapped new resources, with some using both. The report, released twice a year, said global energy prices surged 32 per cent in 2026, reaching their highest level since 2022's invasion of Ukraine by Russia. With oil output down, Brent oil prices were expected to remain elevated in the near term, averaging $92 per barrel for the year. Prices would be even higher if oil demand were not forecast to drop 2.5 per cent this year, the third-largest drop behind the 2020 COVID shock and the 1980 oil crisis. It said food commodity prices were set to rise just over 10 per cent in 2026 due to grain shipment disruptions caused by hostilities between Russia and Ukraine in the Black Sea, and another 7 per cent-plus in 2027, for a cumulative increase of nearly 18 per cent. An adverse scenario that coupled a record El Nino, more Black Sea grain shipment disruptions, escalation in the Middle East conflict and ongoing damage to Russian oil infrastructure could drive food prices 12 per cent higher than expected, it said. That could trigger a food crisis like the one seen in the early 2010s, when more than 40 million additional people were pushed into extreme poverty, the bank noted. Fertilizer prices were expected to rise 14 per cent in 2026, due to a surge in urea prices, returning to 2025 levels in 2027. Metals prices were projected to rise 25 per cent and hit a new high in 2026, with aluminum, copper and tin all setting new records as a result of supply disruptions and strong demand from investments in renewable energy, electric vehicles and data centers, the bank said. Precious metals prices were projected to surge by 40 per cent in 2026, amid elevated demand for safe-haven assets triggered by geopolitical and policy uncertainty, with some moderation seen in 2027.

Source: Reuters

FAST

LONDON, Oct 28 : Finance minister John Healey on Wednesday unveiled plans in his budget to support the development of data centres in Britain, linking the measure to the government's artificial intelligence and national security objectives. Healey said the government would launch a new British Data Centre Covenant requiring operators to invest in local communities, create jobs and protect water supplies, in return for priority grid connections and, where necessary, permission to build on-site power generation. "Built on sovereignty and security, I want to ensure that the British people can benefit from the huge potential upsides of AI," Healey told parliament. He said the aim was to keep sensitive data used by public services and the armed forces in Britain as the use of artificial intelligence expands. Healey also announced an AI Challenge Prize to encourage the use of AI in public services and funding to support workers adapting to technological change.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Tuborg maker Carlsberg India moves closer to IPO, files updated DRHP for complete OFS issue
item.description: Carlsberg India has filed an updated draft prospectus with Sebi for an IPO comprising 8.64 crore shares, entirely through an offer for sale by existing shareholders. The Tuborg maker could raise up to $700 million, according to earlier reports, as multinational companies increasingly tap India’s equity markets to monetise local businesses.
item.dc:creator: Akash Podishetti
item.content:encoded: Danish brewing giant Carlsberg's Indian subsidiary has moved closer to its stock market debut after filing an updated draft prospectus with market regulator Sebi for an initial public offering (IPO) comprising 8.64 crore shares, joining a growing list of multinational companies seeking to unlock the value of their Indian businesses.The proposed offering will consist entirely of an offer for sale (OFS) of 86.42 million equity shares by existing shareholders, according to the updated draft red herring prospectus dated October 27.Since the issue is entirely an OFS, Carlsberg India will receive no proceeds from the share sale. The money raised will go to the selling shareholder.The company has yet to announce its IPO price band, subscription dates or the total amount it intends to raise.Carlsberg India had initially submitted its IPO documents through Sebi's confidential filing route in July 2026. The regulator cleared the pre-filing earlier this month, allowing the company to proceed with the public filing.According to earlier Bloomberg reports, the offering could raise as much as $700 million, with the company considering a launch as early as December, subject to market conditions.The company has appointed Kotak Mahindra Capital, Citigroup Global Markets India and JP Morgan India as book-running lead managers.Carlsberg India's planned listing comes amid growing interest from multinational companies in India's equity markets, where valuations have encouraged foreign parents to sell stakes in their local subsidiaries.South Korean automaker Hyundai Motor raised Rs 27,870 crore through its Indian subsidiary's IPO in October 2024, which was then the country's largest public offering. LG Electronics India followed with an Rs 11,607 crore IPO in October 2025, allowing its South Korean parent to monetise part of its investment in the Indian consumer electronics business.Both offerings were structured entirely as offers for sale. Carlsberg is now looking to follow a similar route, offering public market investors an opportunity to own shares in one of India's largest brewing companies.Also read | No. 2 on Day 1: How Jio Platforms broke India’s market cap hierarchy in debut tradeThe proposed issue also comes during a busy period for India's primary market. Jio Platforms made its stock market debut on Wednesday following its Rs 30,188 crore IPO, the largest in India's history. The offering was subscribed 22.19 times and attracted public bids worth Rs 4.9 lakh crore.About Carlsberg IndiaCarlsberg India is one of the country's leading brewing companies, competing with United Breweries, which markets the Kingfisher brand.The company entered India in 2007 and markets beer brands including Tuborg, Carlsberg Elephant and Kronenbourg 1664 Blanc.According to its updated prospectus, Carlsberg India operates seven company-owned breweries and works with nine third-party manufacturers across the country.The company reported a market share of 21.9% across 16 key states and union territories, reflecting its position in India's beer market.Its operations cover different beer categories, including mainstream, strong and premium offerings. Carlsberg India's listed peers include United Breweries, United Spirits, Radico Khaitan and Allied Blenders and Distillers.(Disclaimer: Recommendations, suggestions, views and opinions given by the experts are their own. These do not represent the views of The Economic Times)

item.title: Altman urges firms to prioritise AI security over productivity gains
item.description: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman urged companies to prioritise AI security risks over productivity gains, warning that AI systems are uncovering vulnerabilities requiring urgent action.
item.content:encoded:
Home / Technology / Artificial Intelligence / Altman urges firms to prioritise AI security over productivity gains

Altman urges firms to prioritise AI security over productivity gains OpenAI CEO Sam Altman urged companies to prioritise AI security risks over productivity gains, warning that AI systems are uncovering vulnerabilities requiring urgent action.

OpenAI CEO Sam Altman | Image: Bloomberg

Press Trust of India 4 min read Last Updated : Oct 29 2026 | 12:21 AM IST

Listen to This Article

OpenAI CEO Sam Altman has urged companies to make understanding the security threats posed by artificial intelligence (AI) their top short-term priority, even ahead of using it to boost productivity, saying he was shocked at how many software flaws AI systems were finding.   "If I could recommend only one thing to a company right now to do with AI in the very short term, even more than become super productive with Codex (OpenAI's AI coding tool), it would be to really understand the security threat landscape from AI and mitigate against that," Altman said.   He was speaking in a conversation with Oracle CEO Clay Magouyrk at the Oracle AI World event here.

"I realise that this is probably somewhat annoying for me to say," he said, adding that it might seem like "you're creating the problem, now you're telling us we have to spend or work on the solution."   Magouyrk disagreed. "AI is not creating the problem. AI is not creating these bugs. AI is helping us discover all of the security issues that we have developed over the past 50 years," he said. Also Read

BFSI Insight Summit: Sebi explores domestic AI model for securities market

India not yet a consensus buy amid oil, tech disruptions: Global brokerages

Indian startups listing younger, AI firms could follow: Accel's Swaroop premium

AI is not a bubble yet, but volatility lies ahead, says Shankar Sharma

Valuation of AI stocks, volatility pose risks for investors: Fund managers

Agreeing with the Oracle CEO, Altman noted that the only way through is to find all these issues and fix them, and that new methods would be needed because it is "too hard to patch every bug one by one across the entire supply chain that we all depend on."

He said companies would need new kinds of services that constantly monitor traffic and stop such flaws from being exploited. "I find myself shocked at just how many vulnerabilities these AI systems are finding," Altman said, adding that it would take a "herculean effort" to get ahead of the problem.   His remarks come days after a coalition of researchers and security firms led by OpenAI used AI agents to uncover serious flaws in PHP. PHP is a programming language that sits behind a majority of websites today.   On October 21, the cyber division of the US Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) warned that the flaws could let attackers run code remotely and advised taking websites offline if they could not be updated immediately.

Cloudflare CEO Matthew Prince reported "millions" of attempts to exploit the flaws within hours of the announcement.   OpenAI called the flaws "one of the most impactful security issues in recent memory" and said AI appeared to have found them before any attackers did.   OpenAI has also faced security incidents involving its own models. In July, the company said AI agents it was testing for cybersecurity capabilities had escaped their isolated test environment and broken into the systems of AI platform Hugging Face.   The models' deployment safeguards had been intentionally switched off for the test. OpenAI said at the time that "this incident   points to the need to further strengthen our model's alignment".

In September, OpenAI temporarily halted training, evaluation and tool-based use of its most capable models after an AI agent on a search task reached a public chatbot service through a gap in its internet-access restrictions.   It disclosed this in a blog post on September 25.   Altman said the pace of change in AI had been one of the biggest surprises for him this year. When OpenAI launched ChatGPT almost four years ago, its models "couldn't solve grade school math, and now they're like knocking down the hardest, unproven math problems we know of," he said.   GPT-6, OpenAI's latest model, has seen "our strongest adoption by far of any new model", he said.

AI is also letting people who never thought of themselves as programmers build their own apps, Altman pointed out. Describing his own experience of using the latest tools, he said, "It's like I am managing a factory inside of my computer, and I can get things that I don't enjoy doing to be automated
